an10.118:1.1: “Monks, I will teach you the near shore & the far shore.
an10.118:1.2: Listen & pay close attention. I will speak.”
an10.118:1.3: “As you say, lord,” the monks responded to the Blessed One.
an10.118:2.1: “And which is the near shore? And which is the far shore?
an10.118:2.2: “Wrong view is the near shore; right view, the far shore. “Wrong resolve is the near shore; right resolve, the far shore. “Wrong speech is the near shore; right speech, the far shore. “Wrong action is the near shore; right action, the far shore. “Wrong livelihood is the near shore; right livelihood, the far shore. “Wrong effort is the near shore; right effort, the far shore. “Wrong mindfulness is the near shore; right mindfulness, the far shore. “Wrong concentration is the near shore; right concentration, the far shore. “Wrong knowledge is the near shore; right knowledge, the far shore.
an10.118:2.3: “Wrong release is the near shore; right release, the far shore.
an10.118:2.4: “This, monks, is the near shore; this, the far shore.”
an10.118:4.1:
But those who practice Dhamma
in line with the well-taught Dhamma,
an10.118:4.4:
will cross over the realm of Death
so hard to transcend.
an10.118:5.2:
the wise person
should develop the bright,
an10.118:5.3:
having gone from home
to no-home
an10.118:5.4: in seclusion, so hard to enjoy.
an10.118:6.1: There he should wish for delight,
an10.118:6.2:
discarding sensuality—
he who has nothing.
an10.118:7.4:
who delight in non-clinging,
relinquishing grasping—
an10.118:7.6:
They, in the world,
are unbound.
